envVars.name: ARENA_MCP_ALLOW_TRADE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the paper-trade tools (place_trade, sell_trade, cancel_order, settle_open). Any other value leaves trading off.

envVars.name: ARENA_ALLOW_RESET
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register reset_account, which resets the paper account to a new run at $100,000 after the person agrees. The server also refuses until the owner turns resets on in Settings on the web. Any other value leaves it out.

envVars.name: ARENA_MCP_ALLOW_KEYS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register revoke_api_key, which revokes one of the account's API keys when the person asks (confirm: true). Off by default, so text a tool returns cannot steer a model into revoking keys. list_api_keys is always registered. Any other value leaves it out.

envVars.name: ARENA_CREDENTIALS_FILE
envVars.description: Optional path to a credentials file for headless or CI use. By default the server reads the credentials that `arena login` stored.

envVars.name: ARENA_API_KEY
envVars.description: Optional Arena API key (arena_sk_...) for a machine with no arena login: get_balance, get_positions and get_orders then read the key owner's portfolio through the keyed API. A session always wins there. get_my_eval reads with it when it is set, else with the sign-in. Trade tools still need arena login.

envVars.name: ARENA_API_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Optional full path to a file holding the API key (arena keys create --save writes one, mode 0600). Used when ARENA_API_KEY is not set. With neither set, the server reads ~/.config/arena/arena.key when it holds a key (the file the CLI and the Python SDK read).

servers.description: BlueCat Integrity MCP Server (formerly bammcp)

envVars.name: BAM_BASE_URL
envVars.description: BAM base URL (e.g., https://bam.bluecat.com).

envVars.name: BAM_USERNAME
envVars.description: BAM service-account username. Required unless the SSO pair (BAM_SSO_USERNAME + BAM_SSO_PASSWORD) is used instead — the server needs exactly one of the two pairs.

envVars.name: BAM_PASSWORD
envVars.description: BAM service-account password. Required alongside BAM_USERNAME, unless the SSO pair is used instead.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_USERNAME
envVars.description: BAM SSO username. Alternative to BAM_USERNAME + BAM_PASSWORD; the server needs exactly one of the two pairs.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_PASSWORD
envVars.description: BAM SSO password. Required alongside BAM_SSO_USERNAME when using the SSO pair.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Client authentication mode for the /mcp endpoint. One of: none | static-key | signed-key | resource-server. Required at runtime — the server refuses to start without it (no default).

envVars.name: MCP_API_KEY
envVars.description: Static bearer token clients present as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Required only when MCP_AUTH_MODE=static-key.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY
envVars.description: HMAC key (at least 32 bytes) sealing the approval-gated write tools' requestState on MCP 2026-07-28 connections (#1031). Optional: unset uses a random per-process key, which is fine for a single replica; set the same value on every replica of a multi-replica deployment.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY_PREVIOUS
envVars.description: Second requestState HMAC key, accepted for opening a sealed plan but never for sealing one: two-key rotation of MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY (#1032). Optional, and only valid together with MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY. When rolling the key across replicas set this to the old key, and remove it two minutes after the last replica restarted.

envVars.name: MCP_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 public key (base64url) that MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key verifies license tokens against. DEFAULTS TO A SHARED DEMO KEY, which authenticates a token holder rather than a customer — every BlueCat-issued token for this server verifies against it. For anything beyond a trial, generate a per-deployment key pair (license-keygen --gen-key) and set this to its public half.

envVars.name: MCP_SIGNED_KEY_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: When set, a license token must carry exactly this audience or it is rejected — a declarative scope check on top of the key, so a token minted for another deployment fails even if it verifies. Unset means the aud claim is not checked. Only meaningful with MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
envVars.description: Token issuer URL, matched against the iss claim of incoming JWTs. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint whose public keys verify the signature on every incoming Bearer JWT. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT aud claim for MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server. A token carrying a different audience, or no aud claim at all, is rejected. Unset skips audience validation entirely.

envVars.name: ACCEPT_EULA
envVars.description: Set to Y (or Yes/YES, any casing) to accept the BlueCat End User License Agreement. The container refuses to start without it.

envVars.description: Optional. Service role key for check_rls. Sent only to your Supabase project, never printed.

envVars.name: SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional. Supabase management token for check_rls and the auth config check. Sent only to the Supabase management API.

envVars.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
envVars.description: Optional. Supabase project ref, used with SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN.

envVars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Optional. Stripe secret key for check_stripe. Sent only to api.stripe.com, never printed.

envVars.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional. Project-scoped Vercel token for check_vercel_env. Sent only to api.vercel.com, never printed.

envVars.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
envVars.description: Optional. Vercel project id for check_vercel_env.

envVars.name: SECUREALY_VERCEL_DECRYPT
envVars.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_vercel_env fetch decrypted variable values from api.vercel.com for the trailing-newline and live-key checks. Without it only names and targets are read and those checks are reported as skipped.

envVars.name: SECUREALY_SUPABASE_HOST_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_rls send the service key to a self-hosted Supabase URL. Without it the key is sent only to an https URL on a Supabase-hosted domain.

envVars.name: SECUREALY_SCAN_ROOTS
envVars.description: Optional. Folders, separated by the OS path delimiter, that scan_repo may read in addition to the server's working directory. Anything outside is refused.

envVars.name: SECUREALY_NO_HISTORY
envVars.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop the server appending each run (grade, score, counts, failing check ids; never evidence) to .securealy/history.json in its working directory.

envVars.name: SECUREALY_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: Optional, off by default. Set to 1 to send an anonymous aggregate of each run (command, grade, counts, stack kind, failing check ids; no URL, host or evidence) to securealy.com.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID
envVars.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL
envVars.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1.2.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_MAX_IMAGES
envVars.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions/view_image/usage only, no write or delete tools.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.

servers.name: dev.filelayer/core
servers.title: Filelayer
servers.description: User files for a SaaS, under one person's authority: list, share with an expiry, revoke.

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Your own PostgreSQL, where this library keeps file ownership, grants and the audit chain. Apply node_modules/@filelayer/core/schema.sql once before starting.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_AS
envVars.description: The ONE subject this server speaks for, in your own id space. Fixed for the life of the process: no tool reads it as an argument and no tool can change it, which is the only reason exposing these tools to an agent is safe. Write it yourself or have your provisioning write it, never derive it from a conversation. Serving several people means starting several servers.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_ORG
envVars.description: The organisation this server is scoped to, in your own id space.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_DATA_DIR
envVars.description: A local directory for the bytes. Needs no bucket and no IAM user. Set this OR the S3_* block: with neither, the server refuses to start rather than falling back to memory, which would work in a demo and lose the first real file.

envVars.name: S3_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for example https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Setting it makes S3_BUCKET, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY required.

envVars.name: S3_BUCKET
envVars.description: The bucket. It must be private: this library decides who may be GIVEN a URL and has no say in who the object store will answer. `npx -p @filelayer/core filelayer doctor` reports whether yours serves unauthenticated reads.

envVars.name: S3_REGION
envVars.description: Region, or `auto` for Cloudflare R2.

envVars.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Access key id for the bucket.

envVars.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
envVars.description: Secret access key for the bucket.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_AGENT_LABEL
envVars.description: How this agent names itself in the audit trail, recorded on every event these tools produce. It is what lets the chain separate "the partner opened this document" from "the partner's assistant opened this document".

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register delete_file. Off by default because deleting is not recoverable and an agent that misreads a sentence deletes the wrong thing silently.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_EXPOSE_AUDIT
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register file_audit. Off by default because the trail is an organisation's whole history and a tool that returns it copies every file name, actor and denial into the model's context. Reading it is itself audited since 0.27.0, which was the previous reason; the default did not move.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_RETURN_BYTES
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register read_file. Off by default because a document returned by a tool is a document copied into a model's context; file_info plus a share link is usually what was actually needed.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: The base of the share URLs this instance mints. Without it, share links come back without a URL.

servers.name: io.form/formio-mcp
servers.title: io.form/formio-mcp
servers.description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.

envVars.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

envVars.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

envVars.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
envVars.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

envVars.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
envVars.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST
envVars.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT
envVars.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.

envVars.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

envVars.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.

envVars.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

envVars.name: LOADER_PATH
envVars.description: Directory Spring Boot's PropertiesLauncher scans for extension jars; already set to /app/adapters by the image, but startup still fails with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER until you bind-mount a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar there (see the -v arguments above)

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer that mints the caller's JWT; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT audience claim for this deployment; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS location used to verify caller JWTs; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI is required, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI
envVars.description: Alternative HTTPS OIDC issuer-discovery location; set this instead of DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_PRINCIPAL
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's principal identifier; required, must differ from the roles and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_ROLES
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's roles; required, must differ from the principal and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_INVESTIGATION
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the trusted investigation/case identifier; required, must differ from the principal and roles claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_POLICY_PURPOSES
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of permitted purposes; at least one is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_INVESTIGATOR
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_<ROLE> per operator-defined role (no underscore between SECURITY and POLICY: Spring Boot's map-key enumeration under a hyphenated dataprism.security-policy.roles.<role> segment only binds the concatenated prefix, verified by binding this property directly against Spring Boot 4.1.1), a comma-separated list of known MCP tool capabilities; at least one role-to-capability mapping is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_PROFILE
envVars.description: Name of the reviewed privacy profile implementation to apply; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_SCOPE_LIFETIME
envVars.description: Positive duration (e.g. 8h) a privacy scope's synthetic identities remain valid; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Identifier of the pinned HMAC key used to derive synthetic identities; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE
envVars.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC key material; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE is required, never both, and never a literal key value

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE
envVars.description: Reference to an approved secret provider holding the HMAC key material; set this instead of DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit sink implementation: one of approved-sink, slf4j, hash-chained; required, never downgraded to no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_WRITER_ID
envVars.description: Writer/instance identity recorded on every audit entry; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_FILE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the durable, hash-chained audit log; required when DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK=hash-chained, refused as MISSING_AUDIT_FILE_PATH if absent for that sink, ignored otherwise

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_METRICS_SINK
envVars.description: Metrics sink binding, currently only micrometer; required in production, never the framework no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY
envVars.description: Cluster read-budget topology: embedded (shared across members that have joined one cluster; set cluster name and join mode) or single-node (enforced per process); required, never defaulted

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_CLUSTERNAME
envVars.description: Hazelcast cluster name; required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY=embedded, never dev, refused if set with single-node

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MODE
envVars.description: How cluster members find each other: tcp-ip, kubernetes or none; required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY=embedded (none is an explicit single member bound to 127.0.0.1), refused if set with single-node

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MEMBERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated member addresses (host or host:port); required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MODE=tcp-ip, otherwise unused

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_MEMBER_PORT
envVars.description: Hazelcast member port, default 5701, never auto-incremented; must differ from the server, management and operator ports. Member traffic is unencrypted, so keep it on a private network. Optional

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enables the operator surface; optional, off by default

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_PORT
envVars.description: Port of the operator listener; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true, must differ from the server, management (OPERATOR_PORT_SHARED otherwise) and member ports, and has no fixed default (publish it explicitly)

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_REQUIREDAUDIENCE
envVars.description: JWT audience an operator token must carry; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_REQUIREDSCOPE
envVars.description: JWT scope an operator token must carry; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_BASE_URL (HTTPS) per configured source; at least one source, each with its own reviewed DataSourceAdapter bean, is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_TIMEOUT (positive duration) per configured source; required alongside its base URL

envVars.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
envVars.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_LINEAGE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

servers.description: Arc browser MCP for macOS: agent window, snapshots, DevTools input, guardrails

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL
envVars.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_SPACE
envVars.description: With ARC_MCP_WINDOW=space, the Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW
envVars.description: "dedicated" keeps agent tabs in one separate agent window, never the user's own. "space" puts them in the Agent space of the user's window. Defaults to "dedicated".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW_PLACEMENT
envVars.description: Where the agent window goes once, at creation: "auto" (largest non-main display, else where Arc puts it), "second-display", "minimized" (experimental) or "none". Needs Accessibility. Defaults to "auto".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds the user must have been idle before the server does anything visible. 0 turns the activity gate off. Defaults to 1500.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_WAIT_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds to wait for that pause before failing with userActive true. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ARC_DATA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory the local data tools (sidebar_tree, find_stale_tabs, search_archive, search_history) read Arc's files from. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Arc.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOW_HISTORY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let search_history run. Off by default, and any other value leaves it off.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP
envVars.description: Set to 0 to disable the DevTools engine (trusted input, screenshots, console and network capture). On by default, and inert until Arc is launched with --remote-debugging-port.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP_PORT
envVars.description: The DevTools port to probe on 127.0.0.1. The host is fixed. Defaults to 9222.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may touch (host, *.host, scheme://host[:port], file://, about:). Anything not listed is refused. Unset means no allow list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may not touch. Wins over the allow list. Unset means no block list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCK_READS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to apply the origin lists to read tools as well as changing ones. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read-only tools. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
envVars.description: Path of a file that gets one JSON line per changing call (time, tool, tab, origin, ok, error), never typed values or script code. Unset means no audit log.

servers.description: MCP server bridging OpenGrok search engine with AI for instant context across massive codebases.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenGrok server base URL (e.g. https://opengrok.example.com/source/)

envVars.name: OPENGROK_USERNAME
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication username. Leave unset for anonymous access.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
envVars.description: Enable Code Mode: 2-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Reduces AI token usage by ~90%.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_MEMORY_TOOLS
envVars.description: Register the 3 memory tools in Code Mode (memory status, read, update). Off = api + execute only.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
envVars.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
envVars.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION
envVars.description: OpenGrok REST API version. Use v2 for call graph features (requires OpenGrok 1.12+).

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
envVars.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING
envVars.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
envVars.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API
envVars.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER
envVars.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS
envVars.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM
envVars.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT
envVars.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS
envVars.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP
envVars.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF
envVars.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_GRAMMAR_DIR
envVars.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammars. Overrides the bundled grammar lookup.

servers.name: io.github.IlyasKhallouki/hypruse
servers.title: hypruse
servers.description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
envVars.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
envVars.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
envVars.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
envVars.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN

servers.description: Facebook Pages MCP server for the Meta Graph API — publishing, insights, moderation, messaging

envVars.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
envVars.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

envVars.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
envVars.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

envVars.name: FB_APP_ID
envVars.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

envVars.name: FB_APP_SECRET
envVars.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_ID
envVars.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

envVars.name: FB_API_VERSION
envVars.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

envVars.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

envVars.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

envVars.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
envVars.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

envVars.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

envVars.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
envVars.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

envVars.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

envVars.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

envVars.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

envVars.name: FB_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

envVars.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

envVars.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
envVars.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

envVars.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.

envVars.name: X_MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Authentication mode: oauth2 (default) or app-only.

envVars.name: X_MCP_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID (oauth2 mode).

envVars.name: X_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (confidential clients only).

envVars.name: X_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Application-only bearer token (app-only mode).

envVars.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the rotating OAuth 2.0 token store (default: OS-resolved).

envVars.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN
envVars.description: Set to 1 to keep OAuth 2.0 tokens in the OS keychain (macOS, Linux) instead of a token file. Mutually exclusive with an explicit X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.

envVars.name: X_MCP_POLICY
envVars.description: Policy preset: read-only (default), engage, publish, manage, or full.

envVars.name: X_MCP_POLICY_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to allow on top of the preset (e.g. read:dm,write:dm).

envVars.name: X_MCP_POLICY_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to deny; deny beats allow beats preset.

envVars.name: X_MCP_HIDE_DENIED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to drop policy-denied tools from registration entirely instead of registering them annotated as denied.

envVars.name: X_MCP_MEDIA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory uploads must resolve inside. Media upload is disabled unless this is set.

envVars.name: X_MCP_AVAILABILITY
envVars.description: Comma-separated specially-provisioned access classes to declare: pilot, premium-user, enterprise. Unset means the conservative default (app+user, user-only).

envVars.name: X_MCP_PROFILES_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a profiles file holding named configuration blocks.

envVars.name: X_MCP_PROFILE
envVars.description: Name of the profile to select from the profiles file.

envVars.name: X_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: X_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Diagnostic verbosity on stderr: silent, error, info (default), or debug.

envVars.name: X_MCP_CREDIT_BUDGET
envVars.description: Session spend cap in USD.

envVars.name: X_MCP_BUDGET_MODE
envVars.description: Budget enforcement: warn (default) or hard.

envVars.name: JUNE_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Your June endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the Junê desktop app's local engine, your own june-local service, or a hosted Team workspace)

envVars.name: JUNE_CANVAS
envVars.description: The canvas (workspace) to bind this connection to — a name (e.g. 'work') or a canvas id; names resolve at startup and ambiguous names fail closed

envVars.name: JUNE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Your June API key (set JUNE_ALLOW_ANON=1 instead to explicitly opt out for keyless local setups)

envVars.name: JUNE_LLM_KEY
envVars.description: Bring-your-own LLM key for cited answers — forwarded per-request as a header, never logged or stored on the service

envVars.name: JUNE_CANVAS_CREATE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to create the named canvas on first run if it doesn't exist yet (refused in read-only mode)

envVars.name: JUNE_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to hide and refuse all write tools (memory becomes read-only)

envVars.name: JUNE_FILES_ROOT
envVars.description: Opt-in directory agents may upload files from via june_ingest_file — unset means that tool doesn't exist

envVars.name: JUNE_DOCS_CANVAS
envVars.description: Canvas holding the agent's standing docs/skills/learnings (default 'agent_docs')

envVars.name: JUNE_DOCS_REFRESH
envVars.description: Set to 0 to disable the periodic standing-docs digest re-injected on tool results (default on)

envVars.name: JUNE_REFRESH_CALLS
envVars.description: Tool calls between digest injections (default 12) — lower it for small-context agents

envVars.name: JUNE_REFRESH_MINUTES
envVars.description: Wall-clock fallback between digest injections (default 10)

envVars.name: JUNE_DIGEST_CHARS
envVars.description: Standing-docs digest size cap in characters (default 2000)

envVars.name: JUNE_EXPORT_ROOT
envVars.description: Opt-in directory for repo sync — enables june_docs_export / june_page_export / june_page_import (fenced writes, commit-only git); unset means those tools don't exist

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES
envVars.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE
envVars.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
envVars.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
envVars.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
envVars.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
envVars.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).

servers.name: io.github.Nizoka/zipnative-mcp
servers.title: zipnative MCP — ZIP creation, inspection, secure extraction & verification
servers.description: ZIP MCP server: create, inspect, verify, extract securely, modify without recompression. 13 tools

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_PROFILE
envVars.description: Capability profile: 'readonly' (inspect/read only), 'safe' (read + input + window — default), or 'full' (also os + fs tools).

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_OS
envVars.description: Set to '1' to allow the 'os' tools (launch_app/run_program/open_path, kill_process, manage_process, control_service, set_env, registry_get/registry_list/registry_set) AND the 'fs' tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) regardless of profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and UMBRIEL_ALLOW.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR
envVars.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT
envVars.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
envVars.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
envVars.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

envVars.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

envVars.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
envVars.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

envVars.name: MCP_METRICS
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
envVars.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
envVars.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

envVars.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

envVars.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
envVars.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Type of MCP server transport

servers.name: io.github.SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp-server-pro
servers.title: io.github.SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp-server-pro
servers.description: Free-to-start portable memory for AI agents: encrypted, shareable, provably erased. Join SAIHM.

envVars.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
envVars.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.net/mcp.

envVars.name: SAIHM_SELF_JOIN
envVars.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool creates a non-custodial identity on this device and starts activating its free memory, which needs one browser sign-in; no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

envVars.name: SAIHM_MASTER_SECRET_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join, are restoring an existing identity, or saved the key that saihm.net/free gives you. Never transmitted.

envVars.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY
envVars.description: An identity token written by export-identity: brings an existing SAIHM identity to this machine or a hosted agent environment without copying a key file. Set together with SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE; leave both unset to use this machine's own identity.

envVars.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: The passphrase export-identity generated for SAIHM_IDENTITY. The two together are the identity: store it as a secret.

envVars.name: SAIHM_TIER
envVars.description: The plan this identity onboards with (FREE, PRO, PRO_FAST, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_FAST). Defaults to FREE while self-join is on (the default); set it for a paid plan, and with SAIHM_SELF_JOIN=0 for every plan, FREE included. An export-identity token carries its own, which a non-empty value here overrides.

envVars.name: SAIHM_PAYMENT_METHOD
envVars.description: The payment rail of a paid plan, e.g. stripe. Required for a paid SAIHM_TIER unless an export-identity token carries it.

envVars.name: SAIHM_EPHEMERAL_HOME
envVars.description: Set it (e.g. 1) where the home directory is discarded at session end: the join then refuses to create a key. 0 declares the home kept and overrides the host's own signal. Unset: detected where the host says so.

envVars.name: SAIHM_HOME
envVars.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm. Give a full path: a relative one (a JSON config does not expand ~) is refused at start. Also the fallback state directory when SAIHM_STATE_DIR is unset.

When set, direct-mode sessions and the discovery tools resolve templates published there in addition to the bundled ones, falling back to bundled offline. Omit to use only the bundled templates.

servers.name: io.github.Sofiia7/actually
servers.title: io.github.Sofiia7/actually
servers.description: Matches news to Polymarket markets and returns the market's probability. Optional capped trading.

envVars.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_MAX_ORDER_USD
envVars.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
envVars.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_ENABLE_REDEEM
envVars.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_SEARCH_FALLBACK
envVars.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_SPEND_STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_URL
envVars.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.

envVars.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_SECRET
envVars.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.

envVars.name: ARC_NETWORK
envVars.description: Which chain this instance serves: "arc-testnet" (default), "base-mainnet", "base-sepolia" or "arc-mainnet". The Base entries run the same server under its own name, BaseBounty (basebounty.app), with every address baked in. "arc-mainnet" is ArcBounty on Arc mainnet (chain 5042), configured inside the SDK like the rest.

envVars.name: BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Optional BountyAdapter override, testnets only. Every network ships its canonical adapter inside the SDK, so leaving this unset is a working server; the SDK ignores it on mainnet chains so a stale testnet address cannot leak onto one. Addresses: contracts/DEPLOYMENTS.md in the repo.

envVars.name: ARC_RPC_URL
envVars.description: RPC URL override for the resolved network, whichever it is. Defaults to that network public endpoint if unset.

envVars.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run in read-only mode (browsing bounties needs no credentials).

envVars.name: CIRCLE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.

envVars.name: ENTITY_SECRET
envVars.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet entity secret.

envVars.name: CIRCLE_WALLET_ID
envVars.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet ID.

envVars.name: CIRCLE_WALLET_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet address.

envVars.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_REWARD_USDC
envVars.description: Optional, default 20. The largest reward post_bounty accepts for one bounty, in USDC.

envVars.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_SPEND_USDC
envVars.description: Optional, default 50. The most post_bounty posts in total during one run of the server, in USDC.

envVars.name: APP_TEMPLATE_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/app-template checkout that scaffold_app serves and add_agent_setup executes. Default: ../app-template, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.name: DOCS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/docs checkout that docs_search reads. Default: ../docs, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.name: ABAP_CLOUD_GUI_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/abap-cloud-gui checkout (with npm ci done) whose report2cloud converter migrate_report runs. Default: ../abap-cloud-gui; no mirror.

envVars.name: POPUPS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/popups checkout whose popups migrate_report with deploy: true writes into the dev sandbox beside the converted class. Default: .deps/popups of the abap-cloud-gui checkout, ../popups beside it, then its build/popups.

envVars.name: OPENUI5_SRC
envVars.description: OpenUI5 source checkout scope_of reads the JSDoc from (via samples-controls). Default: ../fork-openui5 next to samples-controls.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_WORKSPACE
envVars.description: Where the npm backend installs, the dev sandbox lives and a framework clone lands. Default: ~/.abap2ui5-mcp.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_BACKEND
envVars.description: Which backend runs the apps: npm (the @abap2ui5/node-runtime package, even beside a checkout) or clone (clone the framework). Default: decided per call.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RUNTIME_VERSION
envVars.description: Pin the @abap2ui5/node-runtime release (X.Y.Z) the npm backend installs. Default: the registry's latest.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port of the local backend run_app boots against. Default: 3000.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI
envVars.description: Whether app_start/app_describe/app_act declare their MCP Apps screen (ui://abap2ui5/app-screen): auto (default - when the client advertises the io.modelcontextprotocol/ui extension), on, off.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT
envVars.description: The default answer format of the app tools: snapshot (default) or adaptive-card (the snapshot plus an Adaptive Card 1.5 as an embedded resource, for card-rendering hosts).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_OFFLINE
envVars.description: Set to 1 for no network: no UI5 CDN fallback, no GitHub mirror, no registry lookup.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE
envVars.description: Set to 0 to switch off the read-only GitHub mirror used when no checkout is found.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_DIR
envVars.description: Cache directory of the GitHub mirror. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-remote.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a mirrored copy is used before it is refreshed, in milliseconds. Default: one day.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI5_CACHE_MB
envVars.description: How many MB of UI5 answers from the CDN (sdk.openui5.org) run_app and interact_app keep in memory across calls, so a second boot does not download them again. 0 switches the cache off. Default: 64.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Pages (Chromium tabs) of validate_view's warm render gate, which concurrent calls queue on. Default: 2 (1 to 8).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_CHROMIUM
envVars.description: Chromium binary for run_app and interact_app. Default: CHROMIUM_BIN, Playwright's managed browser, then a system chromium.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCREENSHOT_DIR
envVars.description: Where run_app and interact_app write their PNGs (the newest 50 are kept) and build_backend its log. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-screenshots.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PREBUILT_URL
envVars.description: Where build_backend mode prebuilt downloads the backend from. Default: the framework's release asset.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_WORKER
envVars.description: Set to 0 to run every lint as a fresh abaplint process. Default: a long-lived worker keeps @abaplint/core with the framework parsed and lints a deploy in milliseconds (the CLI runs whenever the worker cannot stand in for it).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: How long the warm lint worker (about 300 MB with the framework parsed) is kept without a request before it exits, in milliseconds; the next lint starts a fresh one. 0 keeps it for the server's life. Default: 10 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of the abaplint run, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCOPE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of scope_of, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of a build, the prebuilt download and the npm install, in milliseconds. Default: 30 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UNIT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of the ABAP Unit runner, in milliseconds. Default: 10 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_URL
envVars.description: Switches on the SYSTEM MODE: the app tools against this real SAP system instead of the sandbox loop. The launch URL, e.g. https://host:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER
envVars.description: System mode: the SAP user the app tools log on with (Basic authentication).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD
envVars.description: System mode: the password of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER. Or A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD, to keep it out of the configuration.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD
envVars.description: System mode: a shell command that prints the password (a keychain lookup) - instead of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: System mode: set to 1 to accept a certificate that cannot be verified. NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the CA is the better fix.

servers.name: io.github.aliasunder/vault-cortex
servers.title: Vault Cortex
servers.description: Standalone MCP server for Obsidian vaults — hybrid search, notes & files, memory, tasks, OAuth 2.1

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.name: PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

envVars.name: RERANK_MODE
envVars.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

envVars.name: WINDOWS_MODE
envVars.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

envVars.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

envVars.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

envVars.name: READONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.

envVars.name: DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.

envVars.name: MEMORY_DIR
envVars.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "Daily Notes".

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT
envVars.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".

envVars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
envVars.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.

envVars.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS
envVars.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.

envVars.name: TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity.

envVars.name: LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.

envVars.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
envVars.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.

envVars.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes). When set, overrides the default entirely.

envVars.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: the daily notes folder, "Templates", and MEMORY_DIR. DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER wins; otherwise .obsidian/daily-notes.json is read per query (fallback "Daily Notes"). When set, replaces the defaults entirely. Set to a comma (,) to exclude nothing; an empty value uses the defaults.

envVars.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

envVars.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_API_URL
envVars.description: Custom API URL (defaults to https://api.zerodust.xyz)

envVars.name: ZERODUST_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for higher rate limits. An agent can issue itself one with the zerodust_register_api_key tool, with no human signup step.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_ALLOW_EXECUTE
envVars.description: Set to "true" to enable the sweep tools. Sweeping moves real funds, so it is off by default and also requires one of the four signing-key variables below.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_SIGNER_MODULE
envVars.description: Path or specifier of a module whose default export returns a viem LocalAccount. This is how Turnkey, Privy, AWS KMS or any other custody service is used, without a raw key ever reaching this server. Preferred over ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to an encrypted V3 keystore (as produced by `cast wallet import` or geth). Requires ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing the keystore password, so the password never enters the MCP config.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Keystore password inline. Prefer ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing a hex private key, so the key stays out of the MCP config.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Private key for the agent's own wallet, inline. Used locally to sign the EIP-7702 authorization and EIP-712 sweep intent; never transmitted, only the resulting signatures are sent. The signer-module, keystore and key-file options above keep it out of your config entirely.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of sweep destinations. When unset, funds can only be swept to the agent's own address.

envVars.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
envVars.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

envVars.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

envVars.name: PG_SSL_CA
envVars.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

envVars.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
envVars.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

envVars.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

envVars.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

envVars.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_HOST
envVars.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PORT
envVars.description: SSH bastion port.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_USER
envVars.description: SSH username.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
envVars.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
envVars.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

servers.name: io.github.attestedintelligence/aga-mcp-server
servers.title: io.github.attestedintelligence/aga-mcp-server
servers.description: Verifiable decision records for AI agents: signed receipts for calls to its own governed tools.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 seed, 64 hex characters, that signs this server's evidence-bundle receipts and checkpoint, so gateway_public_key (get_server_info) is the same after a restart and can be pinned. Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_SEED_PHRASE
envVars.description: 12-word BIP-39 phrase for the blind vault. Optional: without it the server works exactly as before. With it, sealed:true encrypts a memory on your machine and computes its search vector here, so sealed memories can still be found, and searches send the query's vector instead of its text. Generate one with chainmemory_new_seed. It never leaves your machine and cannot be recovered.

envVars.description: API base URL (default: https://api.chainmemory.ai)
