envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_ALLOW_FULL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let get_project_brief return the FULL level (addresses, ports, server paths and security rules) when you ask for it. Leave it empty to keep every brief at the public level, which is safe to paste anywhere. Works only with the owner's key, and ChainMemory logs every full-level request.

envVars.name: AICHAIN_KEY
envVars.description: NOT NEEDED for normal use — leave it empty. Only the chainmemory_seal tool reads it, to sign a contract call yourself instead of letting the API anchor the memory (which chainmemory_remember already does). If you do set it, it is a wallet private key: use a dedicated wallet holding only a few AIC, never your main one. No other tool uses it.

envVars.name: AICHAIN_RPC
envVars.description: RPC endpoint used only by chainmemory_seal (default: https://rpc.chainmemory.ai). Leave it empty unless you set AICHAIN_KEY.

envVars.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
envVars.description: Your Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Needed for Apple Music (official API), Apple Maps and WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Key ID of a private key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys with Media Services (MusicKit), MapKit JS and/or WeatherKit enabled.

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Local installs only: a path to the .p8 file instead of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Music (pair with APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Music.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_SERVICE_ID
envVars.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
envVars.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
envVars.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

envVars.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: APPLE_SERVICES
envVars.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

envVars.name: APPLE_UNITS
envVars.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

envVars.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

envVars.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
envVars.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
envVars.description: "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE flow. Set it for a client that says it can prompt but never does (the gated call hangs, e.g. opencode 2.0.x). Any other value stays "on" (with a stderr warning).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
envVars.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

envVars.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE
envVars.description: A Cookie header from an already-signed-in portal session ("sessionid=...; csrftoken=..."). Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.

envVars.name: CROWNTOWN_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your portal.crowntowncompost.com username or email address. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.

envVars.name: CROWNTOWN_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your Crown Town Compost customer-portal password. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.

envVars.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.crowntowncompost-mcp/session.json.

servers.name: io.github.chrischall/evite-mcp
servers.title: io.github.chrischall/evite-mcp
servers.description: Evite for Claude — list events, guest lists & RSVPs, RSVP, message guests, and create/edit events

envVars.name: EVITE_EMAIL
envVars.description: Your Evite login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to a raw session cookie or the fetchproxy browser bridge (requires being signed in to evite.com).

envVars.name: EVITE_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your Evite password. Optional — see EVITE_EMAIL.

envVars.name: EVITE_SESSION_COOKIE
envVars.description: A raw `cookie:` header copied from a signed-in evite.com tab (alternative to email/password). Used verbatim. Optional.

envVars.name: EVITE_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: EVITE_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.evite-mcp/session.json.

envVars.name: EVITE_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Set to true to disable the fetchproxy browser bridge. With the bridge disabled you MUST provide EVITE_EMAIL/EVITE_PASSWORD or EVITE_SESSION_COOKIE. Defaults to false.

envVars.name: EVITE_UPLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Optional. Restrict evite_upload_photo to image files inside this directory (several may be separated by the path delimiter, `:` on macOS/Linux; `~` allowed). A path outside it is refused before anything is read. Unset = any readable image file.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

servers.name: io.github.chrischall/freshbooks-mcp
servers.title: io.github.chrischall/freshbooks-mcp
servers.description: FreshBooks invoicing for Claude — invoices, clients, estimates, and payments

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OAuth client ID from my.freshbooks.com/#/developer

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OAuth client secret

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional for local sign-in, which saves tokens privately. Required for hosted or legacy environment-token setup.

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI
envVars.description: Registered redirect URI; required on refresh calls too (default https://localhost)

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_TOKEN_STORE
envVars.description: Path for the rotating-refresh-token store (default ~/.freshbooks-mcp/session.json)

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_BUSINESS_ID
envVars.description: The integer businessId to work in when the authenticated identity belongs to several businesses. Without it, reads use the first business FreshBooks lists and writes are refused rather than landing in the wrong books.

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Overrides the account id normally resolved from /auth/api/v1/users/me. Set it explicitly when the authenticated identity belongs to no business membership and resolution fails, or, together with FRESHBOOKS_BUSINESS_ID, when FreshBooks reports no account_id for the chosen business (accounting writes are refused until the pairing is confirmed this way).

envVars.name: FRESHBOOKS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request deadline for API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000)

servers.name: io.github.chrischall/gemini-mcp
servers.title: io.github.chrischall/gemini-mcp
servers.description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) image models.

envVars.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Your Google Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey)

envVars.name: GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL
envVars.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-nano-banana-2.1)

envVars.name: GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Default directory for generated images (default: current working directory)

envVars.name: GEMINI_INPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against

envVars.name: GEMINI_UPLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Restrict local-file uploads to the Gemini Files API to these directories (path.delimiter-separated; unset = unrestricted)

envVars.name: GEMINI_REFERENCE_DIR
envVars.description: Restrict local reference images (images / image paths sent to Gemini) to these directories (path.delimiter-separated), plus GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR. Unset: GEMINI_UPLOAD_DIR applies; if that is unset too, unrestricted locally, and $MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads when MCP_DATA_DIR is set (hosted)

envVars.name: GEMINI_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Upstream request timeout in ms (default: 60000, or 120000 for image_size: "4K"); each generation tool also takes a per-call timeout_ms

envVars.name: GEMINI_HEARTBEAT_MS
envVars.description: Progress-notification cadence in ms while a generation runs (default: 10000; 0 disables) — keeps MCP hosts that reset their timeout on progress from timing out long generations

envVars.name: GEMINI_CHAIN_RETRY_MS
envVars.description: How long to wait out interactions-store lag when a chained call 404s (default: 120000; 0 disables retrying)

envVars.name: GEMINI_DEBUG
envVars.description: When set, emit heartbeat diagnostics to stderr. Off by default.

envVars.name: GEMINI_RATE_CARD
envVars.description: Override/extend the shipped USD-per-1M-token rates used by gemini_token_usage's cost estimate, e.g. {"gemini-3-pro-image":{"input":2,"text_output":12,"image_output":120}}. Malformed JSON is ignored (a bad card must not fail generations).

envVars.name: GROUPON_SESSION_COOKIE
envVars.description: Optional, and only for the cart tools. Leave unset to have the ContextMint Bridge browser extension pick up your signed-in groupon.com session. Otherwise paste the full Cookie request header from a signed-in www.groupon.com /mobilenextapi/graphql request (DevTools → Network). It authorizes changes to your Groupon cart, so treat it like a password.

envVars.name: GROUPON_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Set to 1/true to disable the fetchproxy browser-bridge fallback (then the cart path relies solely on GROUPON_SESSION_COOKIE).

envVars.name: GROUPON_GRAPHQL_URL
envVars.description: Override the GraphQL endpoint (defaults to https://www.groupon.com/mobilenextapi/graphql). The cart tools send your session cookie, so they refuse any override that is not an https://*.groupon.com URL.

envVars.name: GROUPON_CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Response-cache TTL for reads in seconds (0 = off; default 60).

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

servers.description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

envVars.name: OFW_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com).

envVars.name: OFW_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see OFW_USERNAME.

envVars.name: OFW_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: OFW_CALENDAR_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to "true" to register calendar write tools (create/update/delete event) in "drafts" write mode. Events have no draft stage but are reversible. Never overrides "none".

envVars.name: OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ
envVars.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

envVars.name: OFW_FETCH_UNREAD_BODIES
envVars.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true to register only healthcheck plus expense tools. All profile/dashboard, message, calendar, and journal tools are structurally absent.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_UPLOAD_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true for strict reimbursement upload mode: only healthcheck, ofw_upload_expense_pdf, ofw_create_expense, and ofw_update_expense register. Implies OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY.

envVars.name: OFW_INLINE_ATTACHMENTS
envVars.description: Set "true" to return attachments as MCP content blocks by default (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Callers can still override per call via the tool's `inline` argument.

envVars.name: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR
envVars.description: Where ofw_download_attachment writes (default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp). Every disk write is confined to it: a saveTo outside it (after resolving symlinks) is refused, and an existing file is replaced only with force:true.

envVars.name: OFW_UPLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may read from (default: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR). Paths outside it after resolving symlinks, hidden files/dirs, and files over 25 MiB are refused.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_IDENTITY
envVars.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Overrides the message cache directory (default ~/.cache/ofw-mcp).

envVars.name: OFW_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).

envVars.name: OFW_AUTO_REFRESH
envVars.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.

envVars.name: OFW_FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.

envVars.name: OFW_SYNC_MAX_REQUESTS
envVars.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).

envVars.name: OFW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.

envVars.name: OFW_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

servers.title: io.github.claymore666/ccu-mcp
servers.description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

envVars.name: CCU_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

envVars.name: CCU_PASSWORD
envVars.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

envVars.name: CCU_USER
envVars.description: CCU username

envVars.name: CCU_HTTPS
envVars.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

envVars.name: CCU_PORT
envVars.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

envVars.name: CCU_PROFILES
envVars.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

envVars.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
envVars.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

envVars.name: CCU_CA_CERT
envVars.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

envVars.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

envVars.name: CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
envVars.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

envVars.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
envVars.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

servers.title: io.github.couchbase/mcp-server-couchbase
servers.description: Couchbase MCP Server - Enable AI agents to connect to and interact with Couchbase clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

envVars.name: CB_USERNAME
envVars.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

envVars.name: CB_MCP_HOST
envVars.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
envVars.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

envVars.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

envVars.name: CB_USERNAME
envVars.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

envVars.name: CB_MCP_HOST
envVars.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

envVars.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_COMEXT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Comext dissemination host, which serves every DS-* dataset code (detailed trade and PRODCOM). Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one dataset's SDMX dataflow structure, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because the structure carries a label for every code the dataset uses: 23 MB, uncompressed, for DS-045409. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because a bulk body streams for minutes where a metadata call answers in seconds. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

envVars.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
envVars.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
envVars.description: Parent directory for DuckDB canvas spill files: a private 'mcp-canvas-XXXXXX' directory is created inside it, so it must be writable by the server process. Defaults to the OS temp directory.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
envVars.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

envVars.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to list eurostat_dataframe_drop, which removes one staged table from a dataframe canvas and leaves its other tables in place. Off by default because a drop cannot be undone; staged tables expire with their canvas either way. Takes effect only with CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

envVars.description: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass. Required by usage policy.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Overpass API endpoint URL. When set, pins every query to this one endpoint and disables mirror failover; OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY sizes it and a |N suffix is rejected. Leave unset to use OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. An entry written url|N gets N slots of its own and adds capacity; an unsuffixed later entry is failover only. Write a | inside a URL as %7C. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Concurrent Overpass queries per endpoint: the pinned OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL and every OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS entry without a |N suffix. A query waits at most 30 seconds in total for a slot. Match the slot budget the endpoint advertises at /api/status.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. An entry written url|N gets N slots of its own and adds capacity; an unsuffixed later entry is failover only. Write a | inside a URL as %7C. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Concurrent Overpass queries per endpoint: the pinned OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL and every OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS entry without a |N suffix. A query waits at most 30 seconds in total for a slot. Match the slot budget the endpoint advertises at /api/status.

servers.description: Semantic code & doc search with keyword boost. AST code nav, auto HF mirror, local, privacy-first.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_WATCH
envVars.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

envVars.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR
envVars.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

envVars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTPS proxy URL for downloading embedding models (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Required only if behind a corporate proxy.

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP proxy URL for downloading embedding models. Fallback if HTTPS_PROXY is not set.

servers.title: SpecMgr
servers.description: An artifact manager for system specifications.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode for the MCP server.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_MCP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind address, SSE/streamable-http mode only.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: TCP port, SSE/streamable-http mode only.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_ADR_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory scanned for Architecture Decision Record (.md) files.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_DOCS_DIR
envVars.description: Shared base directory root for the document-type domains that do not have their own dedicated directory environment variable (req, uc, tsk, qa, prb, gol, rsk, dec, sop, vcr, sysrs). Each domain's own subdirectory is appended automatically, e.g. docs/req.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory scanned for Feature folders (<base>/<id>/README.md).

envVars.name: SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED
envVars.description: Presence-based opt-out for the semantic-similarity search feature (the find_related and find_similar_text tools): set to any value to disable the feature, so that every call returns a structured unavailable result and the embedding model is never loaded, and to skip the similarity phase of the unified server-startup warmup thread. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_WARMUP_DISABLED
envVars.description: Presence-based opt-out for the feat domain's two background cache-warming phases (frontmatter and full-parse) of the unified server-startup warmup thread: set to any value to skip both phases; when set together with SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED, no warmup thread is started at all. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the feat_warmup_disabled field of the specmgr://config resource.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_JAR
envVars.description: Path to a plantuml.jar, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_BIN
envVars.description: Path to an executable speaking the PlantUML CLI contract, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_URL
envVars.description: PlantUML server base URL, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Diagram content is only sent to a PlantUML server if this variable is set. Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

envVars.name: SPECMGR_DIAGRAM_MAX_TITLE
envVars.description: Maximum length (in characters) of a resolved node's title label in the reference-graph diagrams (the get_reference_diagram / get_reference_diagram_all MCP tools and the specmgr diagram refs CLI): labels longer than the limit are cut at the last word boundary within the limit (a hard cut when there is none) with an ellipsis appended; the diagram title itself and unresolved node ids are never truncated. An integer; the default 40 applies when the variable is unset or set to an invalid value (empty, non-integer, or less than 1).

envVars.name: SPECMGR_TESTS_NO_DOTENV
envVars.description: Presence-based test/CI sentinel: set to any value to skip the CLI's module-level default .env load entirely, so the process runs under the CI (source-less) condition whatever the local (gitignored) .env configures; this is what keeps the specmgr coverage-badge pre-commit hook's source-less re-run source-less end-to-end. Unset by default, never set outside test runs.

envVars.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
envVars.description: Cache directory for the semantic-similarity feature's embedding model (the third-party fastembed backend's own variable, not a SPECMGR_* one): set to a directory to cache the model there; an unset or empty value falls back to the default <tempdir>/fastembed_cache, where <tempdir> is the process's temporary directory (e.g. /tmp on Linux). Unset by default. The resolved directory is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.

servers.title: Docling MCP
servers.description: Convert PDFs and other documents to structured formats via Docling, for AI applications.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_CONVERSION_MODE
envVars.description: Conversion mode: 'remote' (default) or 'local' (requires docling-mcp[local] extra).

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Docling Serve instance. Required when conversion mode is remote.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for authenticating with Docling Serve.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Request timeout in seconds for the remote Docling Serve API. Default: 300.0.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_MAX_RETRIES
envVars.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for remote API requests. Default: 3.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_FALLBACK_TO_LOCAL
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to fall back to local conversion when Docling Serve is unreachable.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_KEEP_IMAGES
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to retain page images in converted documents. Default: false.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_IMAGES_SCALE
envVars.description: Image scale factor (e.g. 1.0, 2.0). Increase to avoid tensor batching errors. Default: 1.0.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_OCR
envVars.description: Set to 'false' to disable the OCR pipeline. Default: true.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_TABLE_STRUCTURE
envVars.description: Set to 'false' to disable table structure detection. Default: true.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_PICTURE_DESCRIPTION
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to run a vision-language model to generate textual descriptions for figures and pictures. Requires a VLM to be available on the conversion backend. Default: false.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_PICTURE_DESCRIPTION_PRESET
envVars.description: Preset ID for the picture-description VLM (e.g. 'smolvlm', 'granite_vision'). When unset the backend default is used. Only applies when DOCLING_MCP_DO_PICTURE_DESCRIPTION=true.

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_IMAGE_EXPORT_MODE
envVars.description: Controls how images are rendered when exporting to Markdown. Accepted values: 'placeholder' (default, emits <!-- image -->), 'embedded' (base64 data-URI), 'referenced' (file path / URL).

envVars.name: DOCLING_MCP_CACHE_MAX_DOCUMENTS
envVars.description: Maximum number of documents to keep in the in-memory cache. Oldest (least-recently-used) documents are evicted when the limit is reached. Default: 10.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
envVars.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

envVars.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
envVars.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

envVars.name: OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__ConnectionId
envVars.description: Connection id the agent uses to address documents on the filesystem (any non-empty string). Optional: with nothing configured the server starts with an in-memory session connection whose documents last only while it runs. Set this and RootPath to edit documents on disk instead; SharePoint is OfficeAgent__SharePointConnections__0__*

envVars.name: OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__RootPath
envVars.description: Absolute path to the directory this filesystem connection may read and write documents under. Only .docx is allowed unless OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__AllowedExtensions__N adds more (.pptx for decks or .xlsx for workbooks). Deck connections usually want OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__DefaultChangeMode=Direct because PowerPoint cannot record tracked changes

envVars.name: OfficeAgent__AllowCreation
envVars.description: Set to true to expose create_document, so an agent can author a new file in the connection rather than only editing existing ones. Off by default: creating agent-named files under a connection root is a capability the host should choose deliberately

envVars.name: OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__ConnectionId
envVars.description: Connection id the agent uses to address documents.

envVars.name: OfficeAgent__FileSystemConnections__0__RootPath

envVars.name: IONOS_TOKEN
envVars.description: IONOS CLOUD API token (required for all products except Object Storage)

envVars.description: S3 secret key for IONOS Object Storage

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_LOAD_MODE
envVars.description: Tool registration strategy (the --load-mode flag overrides this). 'eager' (default): register all tools at startup. 'lazy': defer Compute and Object Storage behind 'ionos_load_compute_tools' / 'ionos_load_objectstorage_tools' sentinel tools (requires MCP client support for notifications/tools/list_changed). 'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_TOOL_SCOPE
envVars.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. Every create and delete requires a two-phase confirmation, but that cannot stop a client configured to approve tool calls automatically. Leave unset unless writes are needed.

envVars.name: IRIS_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

envVars.name: IRIS_API_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file whose trimmed contents are the API key (the secret-file pattern Docker and Kubernetes mount). Set this or IRIS_API_KEY, not both; further keys and rotation are security.apiKeys in config.json

envVars.name: IRIS_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)

envVars.name: IRIS_DB_PATH
envVars.description: SQLite database path

envVars.name: IRIS_SQLITE_DRIVER
envVars.description: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22.13+). Unset: native, falling back to node when the native module cannot load

envVars.name: IRIS_SEARCH_BUDGET_MS
envVars.description: How long one trace search may read before it answers with the matches found so far, in milliseconds (50-60000, default 1000)

envVars.name: IRIS_SEARCH_INDEX
envVars.description: on (default) or off. off keeps no full-text index of the traces: writes are cheaper, and a search reads the traces within its time budget

envVars.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

envVars.name: IRIS_HOME
envVars.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)

envVars.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
envVars.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

envVars.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

envVars.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL
envVars.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one judge or citation call (default 0.25)

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MODEL
envVars.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
envVars.description: What the relevance judge may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1); past it answers_the_ask reads the ask lexically

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST
envVars.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_REDACT
envVars.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are

envVars.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH
envVars.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default)

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD
envVars.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT
envVars.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)

envVars.name: IRIS_PORT
envVars.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)

envVars.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on)

envVars.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport

envVars.name: IRIS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http

envVars.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
envVars.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request

envVars.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_URL
envVars.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json

envVars.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Read-only mode: removes every mutating action from the served surface; reads keep working (default: false)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_SAFE_MODE
envVars.description: Safe mode: a mutating action returns a preview card naming the action and echoing its arguments instead of running; reads keep working (default: false)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_EMBEDDED_RESOURCES
envVars.description: Append EmbeddedResource content blocks (clickable links to MCP resources) to get_* tool results (default: true)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names, group names or canonical action IDs to exclude, on every surface (e.g. gitlab_admin,gitlab_runner)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_IGNORE_SCOPES
envVars.description: Skip the scope filter and the read_api narrowing and register all tools regardless of token permissions; a token carrying neither read_api nor api is still refused (default: false)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Largest local file an upload or file-reading action accepts, in bytes or with a KB, MB or GB suffix (e.g. 2GB); at most 1 TB (default: 2147483648, 2 GB)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIRS
envVars.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories an action may read a local file from; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_DIRS
envVars.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories an action may write a downloaded file into; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_IMPORT_DIRS
envVars.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories a project or group import archive may be read from; the working directory (unless it is the filesystem root or your home directory) and the OS temp directory are always allowed. Unused in HTTP mode, which refuses local paths

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPS
envVars.description: Rate limit per credential, in requests per second, on every call that reaches GitLab, with tools/list charged to a bucket of its own; 0, the default on stdio, disables it (default: 0)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size when GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPS is greater than 0 (default: 40)

envVars.name: GITLAB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity (default: info)

servers.description: Advanced analytics, reporting, and safe mutations for Zebrunner. 64 tools, 14 resources, 17 prompts.

envVars.name: ZEBRUNNER_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for your Zebrunner instance (e.g., https://your-instance.zebrunner.com)

envVars.name: ZEBRUNNER_LOGIN
envVars.description: Your Zebrunner username/login

envVars.name: ZEBRUNNER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Your Zebrunner API authentication token (Personal API Token from Settings → API Tokens, or refreshToken from SSO session)

envVars.name: TIMEOUT
envVars.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000)

envVars.name: RETRY_ATTEMPTS
envVars.description: Number of retry attempts for failed API requests (default: 3)

envVars.name: RETRY_DELAY
envVars.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds (default: 1000)

envVars.name: MAX_PAGE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum page size for paginated API requests (default: 100, max: 1000)

envVars.name: DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
envVars.description: Default page size for paginated API requests (default: 10)

envVars.name: DEBUG
envVars.description: Enable debug logging (default: false)

envVars.name: ENABLE_RULES_ENGINE
envVars.description: Enable the rules engine for test case validation (default: auto-detected from mcp-zebrunner-rules.md file)

envVars.name: STRICT_URL_VALIDATION
envVars.description: Enable strict URL validation for security (default: true)

envVars.name: SKIP_URL_VALIDATION_ON_ERROR
envVars.description: Skip URL validation if it fails (less secure, more permissive) (default: false)

envVars.name: ENABLE_RATE_LIMITING
envVars.description: Enable rate limiting for API calls (default: true)

envVars.name: MAX_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND
envVars.description: Maximum API requests per second (default: 5, max: 100)

envVars.name: RATE_LIMITING_BURST
envVars.description: Allow burst of API requests (default: 10, max: 200)

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP server port (required for StreamableHTTP mode)

envVars.name: ZEBRUNNER_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for your Zebrunner instance (e.g., https://your-instance.zebrunner.com)

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode: stdio, http, or auto (default: auto)

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Authentication mode: headers, oauth, or both (default: headers)

envVars.name: MCP_SERVER_URL
envVars.description: Public URL of this MCP server (for OAuth metadata)

envVars.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
envVars.description: Snowflake: account identifier. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_USER
envVars.description: Snowflake: username. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
envVars.description: Snowflake: role to assume. Required to use the snowflake engine; has no default and must never be ACCOUNTADMIN.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Snowflake: path to an RSA private key file for key-pair auth (preferred over SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Snowflake: passphrase for an encrypted SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH key file, if the key is encrypted.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Snowflake: password (discouraged; prefer SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_SERVER_HOSTNAME
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse server hostname (e.g. my-workspace.cloud.databricks.com, no scheme, no trailing slash). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse HTTP path (from the warehouse's Connection Details tab, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/<warehouse-id>). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Databricks: personal access token (simplest auth option). Either this or DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID + DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET is required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client ID (preferred for automated use). Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET as well.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client secret. Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID as well.

servers.name: io.github.mcpsmiths/tracehub-mcp
servers.title: io.github.mcpsmiths/tracehub-mcp
servers.description: Query OTel traces across Jaeger, Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, X-Ray, New Relic, Honeycomb.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TYPE
envVars.description: Which observability backend to query.

envVars.name: BACKEND_URL
envVars.description: Backend API endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:16686 for Jaeger, https://api.datadoghq.com for Datadog, https://api.newrelic.com/graphql for New Relic, or https://api.honeycomb.io for Honeycomb. For the X-Ray backend this is decorative only (e.g. https://xray.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) - never dereferenced for a live request.

envVars.name: BACKEND_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key or auth token. Required for Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, and Honeycomb; not used by Jaeger, Tempo, or X-Ray. For New Relic this must be a User API key, not an Ingest or License key; for Honeycomb this must be a Configuration Key, not an Ingest or Management key.

envVars.name: BACKEND_AWS_REGION
envVars.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required for the X-Ray backend only - X-Ray authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain, not BACKEND_API_KEY.

envVars.name: BACKEND_NEWRELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: New Relic account ID, required for the New Relic backend only - NerdGraph queries are user-scoped, not account-scoped, so this identifies which account's data to read.

envVars.name: BACKEND_HONEYCOMB_DATASET
envVars.description: Honeycomb dataset slug, required for the Honeycomb backend only - the Query Data API is dataset-scoped.

envVars.name: BACKEND_APP_KEY
envVars.description: Datadog Application key, required in addition to BACKEND_API_KEY for the Datadog backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TEMPO_INSTANCE_ID
envVars.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used with BACKEND_API_KEY for Basic Auth (Tempo backend only, required for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo, not needed for self-hosted Tempo).

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_ORG
envVars.description: Sentry organization slug, required for the Sentry backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_PROJECT

envVars.name: KUBECONFIG
envVars.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.

envVars.name: MCP_MODE
envVars.description: Server mode: 'code' (default), compatibility alias 'all', or direct 'tools'.

envVars.name: MCP_CODE_MODE_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated configurable denials inside run_code. Environment overrides JSON; an empty value enables all configurable capabilities.

envVars.description: Argo Workflows capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery.

envVars.name: MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS
envVars.description: Argo CD capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery or explicit remote configuration.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level: 'error', 'warn', 'info' (default), or 'debug'.

envVars.name: MCP_KUBE_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.

envVars.name: MCP_HIDE_SENSITIVE
envVars.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.

envVars.name: MCP_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_JSON_RESPONSE
envVars.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_STATE_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret of at least 32 bytes for signing approval state. Required in HTTP mode and identical across replicas.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_REPLAY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute directory on writable storage shared by every HTTP replica, used to atomically prevent approval replay.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.

envVars.name: KUBE_MCP_FORCE_VM_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Force the standalone code-mode runtime to use node:vm instead of isolated-vm. Set to '1' to enable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_KUBERNETES_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Disable Kubernetes plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_HELM_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Disable Helm plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGO_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGO_TOOLS=off.

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGOCD_PLUGIN
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS=off.
