envVars.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.

envVars.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

envVars.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR
envVars.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING
envVars.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REPORT_UNRESOLVED_LINKS
envVars.description: Set to true to have write, edit and append list, under unresolved_links, the target of each link the call added that get_broken_links reports. Links the note already held are left out. Off by default, leaving those responses unchanged.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI
envVars.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to INDEX_PATH plus .state.json (index.db.state.json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the state is kept in memory. Never written into the vault by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH
envVars.description: Base path for the embeddings files. Defaults beside INDEX_PATH (index-db-embeddings.npy and .json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the vectors are kept in memory and rebuilt at each start. Setting it also lets the provider be auto-detected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE
envVars.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD
envVars.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER
envVars.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE
envVars.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY
envVars.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE
envVars.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
envVars.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS
envVars.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA
envVars.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS
envVars.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS
envVars.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed; setting it turns on search by meaning. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage), but only when EMBEDDINGS_PATH is set. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
envVars.description: Ollama embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY
envVars.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL
envVars.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL
envVars.description: FastEmbed model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN
envVars.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL
envVars.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S
envVars.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S
envVars.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME
envVars.description: Git committer name for auto-commits, and the author name too unless an OIDC claim supplies one; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL
envVars.description: Git committer email for auto-commits, and the author email too unless an OIDC claim supplies one.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_NAME. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS
envVars.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER
envVars.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S
envVars.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR
envVars.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX
envVars.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN
envVars.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
envVars.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL
envVars.description: Chat model id used for summaries.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES
envVars.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
envVars.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S
envVars.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S
envVars.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT
envVars.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_S
envVars.description: Seconds SIGTERM may spend draining in-flight requests before the HTTP server exits. Keep it at or below the termination grace period the orchestrator allows. `0` drops in-flight requests immediately.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, for example `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL
envVars.description: OIDC discovery document URL, for example `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_ADVERTISED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (such as `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
envVars.description: Signing key for issued tokens; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart. Rotating that secret then invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_APP_DOMAIN
envVars.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Explicit auth-mode override, accepting `remote` or `oidc-proxy` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). When unset the mode is auto-detected from which auth variables are set; the override exists because having all four OIDC variables set is ambiguous between those two modes. Other values are ignored with a warning.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKENS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_DEFAULT_SUBJECT
envVars.description: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
envVars.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
envVars.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: Mount path for the MCP endpoint; the health routes derive their prefix from it.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_HEALTH_DETAIL
envVars.description: How much the unauthenticated /health and /health/ready bodies say: status, standard (adds name, version and per-check verdicts), or full (adds redacted reasons; trusted networks only).

envVars.name: PUID
envVars.description: Run the server process as this UID; the container entrypoint reassigns ownership of writable paths to match.

envVars.name: PGID
envVars.description: Run the server process as this GID; pair with PUID to match the owner of a mounted volume.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for every logger in the process, FastMCP's included (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG. The unprefixed FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL still works for one major version and logs a deprecation warning.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_HOST
envVars.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.

envVars.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

envVars.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR
envVars.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING
envVars.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REPORT_UNRESOLVED_LINKS
envVars.description: Set to true to have write, edit and append list, under unresolved_links, the target of each link the call added that get_broken_links reports. Links the note already held are left out. Off by default, leaving those responses unchanged.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI
envVars.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to INDEX_PATH plus .state.json (index.db.state.json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the state is kept in memory. Never written into the vault by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH
envVars.description: Base path for the embeddings files. Defaults beside INDEX_PATH (index-db-embeddings.npy and .json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the vectors are kept in memory and rebuilt at each start. Setting it also lets the provider be auto-detected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE
envVars.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD
envVars.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER
envVars.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE
envVars.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY
envVars.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE
envVars.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
envVars.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS
envVars.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA
envVars.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS
envVars.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS
envVars.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed; setting it turns on search by meaning. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage), but only when EMBEDDINGS_PATH is set. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
envVars.description: Ollama embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY
envVars.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL
envVars.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL
envVars.description: FastEmbed model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN
envVars.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL
envVars.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S
envVars.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S
envVars.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME
envVars.description: Git committer name for auto-commits, and the author name too unless an OIDC claim supplies one; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL
envVars.description: Git committer email for auto-commits, and the author email too unless an OIDC claim supplies one.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_NAME. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS
envVars.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER
envVars.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S
envVars.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR
envVars.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX
envVars.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN
envVars.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
envVars.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL
envVars.description: Chat model id used for summaries.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES
envVars.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
envVars.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S
envVars.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S
envVars.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT
envVars.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.

servers.name: io.github.pvliesdonk/paperless-mcp
servers.title: Paperless MCP
servers.description: Paperless-NGX over MCP: search, read, upload and tag documents; manage correspondents and types.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
envVars.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
envVars.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for every logger in the process, FastMCP's included (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG. The unprefixed FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL still works for one major version and logs a deprecation warning.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_PAPERLESS_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Paperless-NGX REST API, without a trailing slash. The server refuses to start without it.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_API_TOKEN
envVars.description: Paperless service-account token used for outbound API requests. The server refuses to start without it.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
envVars.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_HTTP_RETRIES
envVars.description: Retries for idempotent requests after network errors or 5xx responses.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
envVars.description: Default page size for list tools, from 1 through 100.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public Paperless UI URL for user-visible links; defaults to PAPERLESS_URL.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_S
envVars.description: Seconds SIGTERM may spend draining in-flight requests before the HTTP server exits. Keep it at or below the termination grace period the orchestrator allows. `0` drops in-flight requests immediately.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, for example `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL
envVars.description: OIDC discovery document URL, for example `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_ADVERTISED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (such as `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
envVars.description: Signing key for issued tokens; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart. Rotating that secret then invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_APP_DOMAIN
envVars.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_DENY

envVars.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

envVars.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

envVars.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

envVars.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

envVars.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
envVars.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.

envVars.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

envVars.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.

envVars.name: Q402_API_KEY
envVars.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.

envVars.name: Q402_WALLET_ID
envVars.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

envVars.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE
envVars.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.

envVars.description: Embedding model cache. Defaults to the platform user cache dir, so the ~220 MB model is downloaded once and shared.

envVars.name: CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword weight in the weighted RRF fusion, range 0.0-1.0. 0 is vector-only; higher values raise the BM25 contribution.

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Result grouping filter. 'similar' keeps only the closest group; 'related' also keeps the next one. Unset means no grouping filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Drop results whose vector distance exceeds this value. Lower is stricter. Unset means no distance filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Keep chunks from at most this many best-scoring files. Unset means no per-file filter.

envVars.name: RAG_INSTRUCTIONS_APPEND
envVars.description: Extra paragraph appended to the instructions the server hands the client at connect time, for corpus-specific guidance.

envVars.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
envVars.description: Let ingest_url fetch hosts resolving to loopback, link-local, private, reserved or unspecified addresses. Off by default.

servers.description: Easy-to-setup local RAG server with minimal configuration

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: STORE_IMAGES
envVars.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

envVars.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
envVars.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.

envVars.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX
envVars.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
envVars.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

servers.name: io.github.singleflo/evolution-api-mcp
servers.title: io.github.singleflo/evolution-api-mcp
servers.description: Operate one Evolution API (WhatsApp) instance: chats, history, sending, groups, settings.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_API_URL
envVars.description: URL of your Evolution API server (e.g. https://evolution.example.com). Evolution API 2.x is required.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_INSTANCE_TOKEN
envVars.description: The token of this one instance (Evolution Manager: open the instance and copy its token). The server's global AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY is refused. The instance name and integration are discovered from the token.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Toolsets to enable: a comma list of instance, messaging, chats, contacts, groups, labels, profile, status, catalog, templates, settings, events, integrations, or the presets `core` and `all`. Default: `core` (messaging, chats, contacts). The --toolsets option overrides it.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_ALLOW
envVars.description: Tools that change data the agent may call. `*` (default) allows every tool not denied; `none` makes the server read-only; or a comma list of tool names. Reads are never gated by this list.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_DENY
envVars.description: Tool names the agent may never call. A value set here REPLACES the default list, which is post_status, remove_group_participants, set_webhook, set_event_channel, set_proxy, set_chatwoot_config.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_ALLOW_IRREVERSIBLE
envVars.description: Tools that cannot be undone (logout_instance, delete_message_for_everyone, leave_group, delete_template, delete_chatbot, delete_openai_credential) run only when this is `yes` (also `true` or `1`). Default: no.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_DEFAULT_DELAY_MS
envVars.description: Milliseconds of 'typing...' Evolution shows before each message is sent when a call gives no delay. Integer from 0 to 20000. Default: 1200.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_MAX_WRITES_PER_MINUTE
envVars.description: Maximum number of tools that change data per minute on this server; 0 turns the limit off. Integer, 0 or more. Default: 30.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_FILE_ROOTS
envVars.description: Folders send_local_files may read: absolute paths of existing directories separated by the operating system's path separator (':' on macOS and Linux, ';' on Windows). Default: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Movies and Music in the home folder (those that exist) plus the download folder.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute folder where download_message_media saves received files and export_chat its exports/ folders. Default: ~/Downloads/evolution-api-mcp.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_TIMEZONE
envVars.description: IANA time zone for the times tools show and for times given without a zone, e.g. Europe/Rome. Default: the computer's zone (TZ, then /etc/localtime), else UTC.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_ACCESS_KEY
envVars.description: Ncloud API Access Key

envVars.name: NCLOUD_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Ncloud API Secret Key

envVars.name: NCLOUD_ZONE
envVars.description: Zone: 'pub' (default, Public zone), 'gov' (Government zone) or 'fin' (Financial zone). Selects the API gateways, regions and service catalogue; credentials must be issued by that zone's console. Any other value aborts startup.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_REGION
envVars.description: Ncloud region code. Public zone: KR, JPN, SGN, USWN, DEN. Government zone: KR (KR-CENTRAL), KRS (KR-SOUTH). Financial zone: FKR. Default KR (FKR in the Financial zone).

envVars.name: NCLOUD_TOOL_GROUPS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool groups to load at startup, e.g. 'compute,network,billing' or 'all,-billing'. Unset = all groups. Include the 'dynamic' keyword to start with the core set (common+compute+network+database) AND allow mid-session expansion via the ncloud_enable_tool_group meta tool; without 'dynamic', the listed groups are locked (no runtime expansion). A '-'-excluded group is also refused for dynamic enable. common is always on.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_PRUNE
envVars.description: Set to '1' to strip empty values (null/""/[]/{}) from responses globally.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000). HTTP 429 is always auto-retried up to 2 times; read-only query tools also retry 503/504 and network errors.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_LANG
envVars.description: Language for client error messages: 'en' for English, otherwise/unset is Korean (default).

envVars.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_MAXBYTES
envVars.description: Opt-in response-size guard for read-only tools. When set to a positive byte threshold, large read-only responses are truncated item-by-item to stay under it, adding 'truncated'/'suggestedPageSize' recovery hints. Unset/0 = guard off (response shape unchanged).

servers.description: Obsidian MCP server: semantic search, knowledge graph, and vault editing. No plugin required.

envVars.name: VAULT_PATH
envVars.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

envVars.name: DATA_DIR
envVars.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
envVars.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

envVars.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
envVars.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
envVars.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
envVars.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
envVars.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
envVars.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
envVars.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
envVars.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Each change others see asks you before it acts, which needs a client that shows MCP elicitation questions; following a thread, saving a post or a draft, reminders and typing do not ask.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_ASK_BEFORE_WRITES
envVars.description: mm-mcp asks you before each change others see. Turn it off only where your client does not show mm-mcp's question, and its own approval of each tool call is to be the check instead: a client that approves tools by itself then posts as you with nobody seeing it first.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_CA_FILE
envVars.description: A PEM file of certificate authorities to trust beside your system's, for a Mattermost whose certificate your organisation signed itself. Leave it empty otherwise.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Where save_file writes attachments. Leave it empty for your Downloads directory.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_FORCE_HUMAN_IN_THE_LOOP_IN_CLAUDE_CODE
envVars.description: Only with Ask before posting off: marks each tool that changes what others see so that Claude Code asks a person on every call, whatever its permission mode or rules allow. An agent cannot post on its own while it is on.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_MARK_AI_GENERATED
envVars.description: Mark every post and edit the model writes with Mattermost's own marker for text written with AI.

envVars.name: MM_MCP_RESOURCE_MAX_MB
envVars.description: The most one message carrying an attached file as an MCP resource holds, a binary file counted as its base64. MCP sends a resource whole, and a client drops a message past its own limit, 10 MB for clients built on the TypeScript SDK. A larger one is refused, and read_file or save_file reads it instead. 0 is no limit.

envVars.name: MM_TOKEN
envVars.description: A personal access token or a bot token. Where those are switched off, leave it empty after logging in once with mm-mcp login --url <address> in a terminal, which keeps your session in the system's credential store.

envVars.name: MM_URL
envVars.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.
